title: Magnus Prime
extract:
Magnus Prime is the Primed variant of the  Magnus heavy pistol, with improvements to its critical chance, critical multiplier, and status chance, and slightly faster reload speed. Its shots also uniquely have a chance to grant it 100% Ammo Efficiency for a short duration. It was released alongside  Nidus Prime and  Strun Prime.
It is also a weapon crafting ingredient for  Akmagnus Prime (x2).

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Landing a successful hit (including from Multishot) or inflicting Status damage ( Slash,  Heat,  Toxin,  Electricity, and  Gas procs) with Magnus Prime has a 4% chance to grant the "Chamber Cascade" buff, increasing Ammo Efficiency by 100% for 4 seconds and can be refreshed on subsequent shots.
Can use the Magnus-exclusive  Deadly Maneuvers mod.

Tips
Individual multishot hits, hits from any damage-over-time effect, and multiple targets hit via punch through all roll the chance for Chamber Cascade to activate per shot, making modding any or all of these on to the weapon highly advisable.
A high rate of fire is also useful on Magnus Prime compared to similar weapons. Increasing the weapon's fire rate will not only give it more chances to proc Chamber Cascade per period of time, but the weapon having infinite ammo while the buff is active negates the usual downsides of increasing a weapon's fire rate over damage lowering the efficiency of its ammo usage.
Deadly Maneuvers' critical chance buff can be used to increase the damage of DoT's that scale off of critical hits.
Chamber Cascade can be refreshed while active, potentially allowing the wielder to go for very long periods of time without ever reloading the weapon as long as they're in an enemy-rich environment.
Like many other semi-automatic pistols, Magnus Prime generates noticeable recoil when fired as fast as possible, especially if modded above its base fire rate. Activating Chamber Cascade will exacerbate this, as it encourages the weapon to be fired quickly to spend as much free ammo as possible while the buff lasts, as well as refresh it.

Trivia
Magnus is Latin for "Big" or "Great".

Bugs
When wielded in tandem with a glaive, the weapon parts do not properly move during the reload as with the standard Magnus.
